blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — Two men were killed in two separate shootings less than an hour apart in a city in southern Cebu and a town in northern Cebu on Wednesday, October 7. At 8:40 p.m. that night, a 26-year-old man lost his life after he was shot multiple times by an unidentified gunman in Sitio Oliveros, Barangay Can-asujan, Carcar City, southern Cebu. Authorities identified the victim as an alias “Justin,” 26, a resident of Sitio Boloc-boloc, Barangay Sangat in the neighboring town of San Fernando.
